title: ComposerMind OpenAudio-48k: Studio Audio
subtitle: 94 Lossless 48kHz Tracks with BeatMind AI BPM, Key & Text-to-Music Prompts
description: ComposerMind OpenAudio-48k is an open-access, studio-grade audio benchmark corpus created by Boobalan Arjunan and published by ComposerMind Labs. Comprising 94 strictly unique uncompressed studio-rendered WAV files (3.88 hours, 48kHz 24-bit stereo PCM) with zero digital clipping. Fully annotated with BeatMind AI acoustic metrics (BPM, 24-key harmonic classification, Camelot code, harmonic/percussive ratio, dynamic range) and turnkey natural language training prompts for generative music models (MusicGen, AudioCraft, Stable Audio Open).
